🚨🌎 US RESUMES BOMBING IRAN AFTER APACHE HELICOPTER DOWNED IN HORMUZ

Trump ordered strikes on Qeshm Island, Sirik, Jask, and Bandar Abbas after Iran downed a US Apache helicopter patrolling the Strait of Hormuz — both pilots survived. CENTCOM called it a "proportional response to unjustified Iranian aggression." Iran says it "will leave no attack or threat unanswered."

This is the same strait the US was supposedly blockading to "contain" Iran. Months into this war: no deal, no leverage, no endgame — just escalation.
📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — 9 de junio de 2026 · Palacio Nacional

🇲🇽✊ Teacher salary, four administrations: "With Felipe Calderón: 9,580 pesos. With Peña Nieto it went up to 11,952. With President López Obrador it reached 17,635. Now [under Sheinbaum] it is above 20,000." — Mario Delgado, Education Secretary, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 Base monthly salary for a primary-school teacher. The figure more than doubles between the end of neoliberalism and the second year of the Fourth Transformation. Plus 1,100+ teachers reinstated since 2019.

🇲🇽🌎 Fentanyl seizures at the border down 76% under Sheinbaum. "There is a 76 percent decrease in fentanyl seizures at the border between the start of President Sheinbaum's administration and the last month for which we have records." — Roberto Velasco Álvarez, Foreign Secretary, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 Reporting on a half-hour call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. A bilateral security meeting is scheduled for Friday. The drop in fentanyl flow is the opposite of the Trump administration's public framing.

🔥🇲🇽 On a billionaire calling for violence in the streets. "He cannot [call] for acts of violence. It's fine to disagree, but you don't call for violence. I have no proof, but the extremes meet — it's 1 plus 1." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 On the same day explosive devices were found in vehicles near the historic center, TV Azteca owner Ricardo Salinas Pliego amplified calls for confrontation. Sheinbaum: "Quieren dar una idea de caos en un evento internacional."

🔥🇲🇽 On calls for state repression dressed up as protest. "Doesn't it strike you as strange that they're practically calling 'repress us' — to show our government is just like the ones of 1971? We are not going to fall into provocations." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 1971 = the Halconazo (Corpus Christi massacre) under PRI rule. Sheinbaum reads the violent fringes inside the CNTE mobilization as a setup designed to provoke a state response.

🔥🇲🇽 On corruption — "to the last consequences." "Here, in our government, when there is presumption of a case of corruption, it is investigated and pursued to the last consequences." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 Asked about former officials of past administrations linked to organized crime — including García Luna's pattern of public contracts at inflated prices flowing into private security firms.

🚨🇲🇽 On migrants the US deports across the border — every nationality, no questions. "They arrive in Mexico, they are received, and we see whether they want to return to their country of origin or — if they want to stay in Mexico — under what conditions." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 Mexico receives ICE-deported migrants of any nationality "por razones humanitarias" — the opposite policy of the country deporting them.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 Mexico keeps sending humanitarian aid to Cuba — and will keep doing it. "It is a matter of solidarity. It's a people that needs it." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, 9 June 2026 Asked about Mexico's humanitarian aid to Cuba under the US blockade, Sheinbaum confirmed shipments continue: "y seguiremos apoyando."
